subject.title: fix(net-policy): preserve repeated secret query params

question: Should this PR preserve git install managed-repo cache identity before merge, or may OpenClaw accept duplicate-secret git specs re-cloning after upgrade?
rationale: The code defect is clear, but accepting a rare upgrade-compatibility drift is a maintainer risk decision if the branch is not repaired.

options.title: Require cache-key compatibility
options.body: Preserve or migrate the old git managed-repo key for duplicate-secret specs while keeping the improved display redaction.

options.title: Accept rare update drift
options.body: Merge the display fix knowing existing duplicate-secret git specs may be treated as fresh installs on update.

recommendation.title: Require cache-key compatibility
recommendation.body: Preserve or migrate the old git managed-repo key for duplicate-secret specs while keeping the improved display redaction.
